properties.name: mcp.api.token
properties.description: API token for MCP endpoint auth. Set via MCP_API_TOKEN env var.

properties.name: embedder.url
properties.description: Base URL for the Python ONNX embedder service. Set via EMBEDDER_URL env var. Default: http://localhost:8000.

properties.name: wrapper.url
properties.description: Base URL for the host-wrapper image processing service. Default: http://host.docker.internal:5001.

properties.name: sync.passphrase
properties.description: Passphrase used to derive the AES-256 encryption key for vault sync. Set via SYNC_PASSPHRASE env var.

properties.name: sync.google.service-account-json
properties.description: Full JSON content of the Google service account key. Set via GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON env var.

properties.name: sync.google.drive.folder-id
properties.description: Google Drive folder ID to use as the sync root. Set via GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID env var.

properties.name: sync.upload.cron
properties.description: Cron expression controlling scheduled upload cadence. Set via SYNC_UPLOAD_CRON env var. Default: every 6 hours.
